<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a ketone (functional group broken) and forms an alkane (functional group formed) using a simple ketone SMILES as reference.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkane"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
